section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and procedure for a single cross-sectional study. A convenience sample of 118 individuals (67.8% female) was recruited online, primarily Irish, with a mean age of 30.6 years (SD = 10.7). Participants provided informed consent, and no compensation was offered.
